validation.countSemantics: each surface is emitted twice - the untouched emulator capture and a centred 1:2 crop - so the file count is double the number of distinct screens shown
unverifiedSpecifications: Play Console help page 9866151 is script-rendered and could not be machine-read; the numeric limits used here (icon 512x512 32-bit PNG <= 1024 KB, feature graphic 1024x500 JPEG without alpha, screenshots 320-3840 px per side within a 1:2 to 2:1 aspect window) come from the launch directive and corroborating secondary sources and MUST be confirmed in Console at upload time.
Whether the Console accepts a native 1080x2400 capture is unconfirmed; the 1:2 crop is the default upload and the native file is retained as evidence.
